about: A JavaScript version of Liquid, the template language Shopify and many static sites use.

prs.title: Splitting text on a space works like Shopify
prs.broken: Splitting text on a space kept tabs and line breaks inside the words, and double spaces gave empty items. Shopify splits on any run of whitespace.
prs.changed: I made a single space split on any whitespace and ignore spaces at the start and end, as Shopify does.
prs.matters: Word counts and word lists in templates match what Shopify gives.
